description: This file defines the SecurityPolicyInterface interface for the Twig sandbox security system, outlining methods that must be implemented for security policies.

classes.name: Twig\Sandbox\SecurityPolicyInterface
classes.description: Interface that all security policy classes must implement, defining methods for security checks on tags, filters, functions, object methods, and properties.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Checks if the given tags, filters, and functions are allowed under the security policy.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Verifies if a specific method on an object is permitted.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Verifies if a specific property on an object is permitted.
